body:
## What's New in v1.51.2

- **Fix**: Fixed silent YouTube playback on Linux. The AppImage now bundles the GStreamer libav plugin, and the AUR, .deb, and .rpm packages require it. `Linux` - @nukeop
- **Fix**: Listening history no longer records a track twice when the previous track ends on its own `History` - @nukeop

> **macOS:** If the app won't open, run `sudo xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Nuclear.app` in Terminal.
